query: Find 3 good customer targets for this company and draft outreach emails.
ideal_customer_profile: Runs a live Shopify storefront, confirmed by platform signals.
Sells a broad or educational catalog where shoppers may need help choosing products, variants, routines, compatibility, or bundles.
Has subscriptions, kits, bundles, or cross-sell potential that could support higher basket value.
Shows an active direct-to-consumer operation with clear customer-support or contact pathways.
Is not a competitor, marketplace, agency, SaaS company, parked site, or household-name enterprise account.
Is reachable through a published business email or a clearly identified contact channel.
rejected_candidates: Mate Precision Technologies — rejected because the site is an industrial metalworking manufacturer rather than a relevant Shopify DTC ecommerce brand; no Shopify signal was detected.
Wildwonder — rejected because the page load returned no usable site text, internal links, platform signal, product evidence, or published contact address, so it could not be qualified.

targets.what_they_sell: Seaweed-powered clean skincare and body-care products, including oils, moisturizers, cleansers, serums, sunscreens, sets, travel sizes, and subscriptions.
targets.why_good_fit: OSEA has a large, education-heavy skincare catalog organized by category and skin concern, plus a routine quiz, product sets, subscriptions, and customer support. Shoppers may need guidance on ingredients, concerns, routines, and which products to combine.
fit_signals: Shopify storefront detected.
Catalog spans face care, body care, cleansers, serums, sunscreens, travel sizes, gifts, and sets.
Site organizes products by concerns including anti-aging, brightening, blemishes/oily skin, dry skin, sensitive skin, and pregnancy/postpartum.
Offers a 'Build Your OSEA Malibu Routine' skin quiz.
Offers subscriptions with 10% savings and skip/edit/cancel flexibility.
Publishes customer-support and skincare-studio email addresses.
Family-owned and mother-and-daughter led, according to the About page.
targets.size_estimate: Established, multi-channel clean-beauty brand with a sizeable catalog, subscription program, retail presence, and a dedicated customer-care operation; likely a Growth or Pro fit rather than a very small Starter account.
disqualifiers_checked: Shopify confirmed on homepage and About/Contact pages.
Not an AI shopping, chatbot, support-automation, or ecommerce-app vendor based on pages read.
Not an agency, marketplace, directory, or SaaS company.
No evidence of a competing AI Store Agent found on pages read.

A conversational product finder could reduce model-selection mistakes and support case-plus-accessory bundles.

Offers phone cases, AirPod cases, watch bands, straps, grips, card holders, charging cables, and MagSafe accessories.
Offers custom or 'Make Your Own Case' products and artist/design collections.
Homepage claims the brand is loved by 2+ million people globally; treated as a company claim.
Published hello@pelacase.com address on Contact page.
targets.size_estimate: Scaled DTC accessories brand with broad device coverage, international currency options, multiple accessory categories, and a substantial customer base; likely a Pro or Scale conversation, though enterprise qualification would need traffic data.
disqualifiers_checked: Shopify confirmed on homepage and Contact page.
Live product catalog and active promotions confirmed.
Not an AI shopping, chatbot, support-automation, or ecommerce-app vendor based on pages read.

targets.why_good_fit: COCOLAB combines multiple product systems, flavors, refill formats, bundles, and educational positioning. Its quiz, subscription products, and product-choice questions make it a strong fit for guided discovery, routine building, and cross-selling.

Founded by two sisters, including a dentist and an artist, according to the About page.
Published customer-care, partnerships, press, and dental-professional emails.
